purpose: Convert OSM-mapped Botswana transmission geometry into a planning-grade benchmark electrical model when BPC electrical parameters are unavailable. Values are engineering benchmarks, never observed BPC asset parameters.

sources.name: PyPSA-Earth configuration
sources.use: Voltage-to-standard-line-type mapping, s_max_pu=0.7, transformer benchmark x=0.1 p.u.

sources.name: PyPSA standard line type register
sources.use: Resistance, reactance and nominal current for named standard line types.

conservative.note: Lighter single conductor from PyPSA standard type register.

reference.note: Current PyPSA-Earth default mapping for 132 kV.

high_capacity.note: Higher-current single-conductor sensitivity from PyPSA standard register.
PyPSA-Earth default 220 kV bundled line type.

400.warning: PyPSA's standard register uses 380 kV types. GridIQ retains the observed 400 kV network voltage and labels conductor parameters as a 380 kV benchmark proxy.

conservative.note: 380 kV standard type used as proxy for mapped 400 kV corridor.

reference.note: 380 kV standard type used as proxy for mapped 400 kV corridor.

high_capacity.note: PyPSA-Earth default EHV bundled line type; mapped 400 kV voltage retained for rating calculation.

transformer_benchmark.warning: Not used as a claim about any BPC transformer; only a sensitivity placeholder if a future cross-voltage benchmark study is explicitly enabled.

evidence_policy.observed: OSM geometry/tags and Botswana official statistics
evidence_policy.derived: Lengths, graph connectivity, nearest-node mapping and scenario outputs computed from observed inputs
evidence_policy.benchmark: Electrical parameters and security factors copied from documented external engineering libraries
evidence_policy.unknown: BPC conductor, exact circuits when not tagged, switch state, thermal rating, impedances, real loading and asset condition
